# Termyte

Termyte gives coding agents the project context they need, so developers do not have to repeatedly explain what happened, why, and what remains.

## Index

- `README.md` - concise product overview
- `docs/README.md` - public docs landing page
- `docs/getting-started.md` - install, verify, and use
- `docs/how-it-works.md` - capture to retrieval flow
- `docs/comparisons.md` - mem0, agentmemory, claude-mem
- `docs/limitations.md` - current gaps and honest boundaries

## Code Truth

- `src/cli/index.ts`
- `src/context/pipeline/memory-pipeline.ts`
- `src/storage/store.ts`
- `src/context/builder.ts`
- `src/tasks/service.ts`
- `src/tasks/checkpoints.ts`
- `src/tasks/resume.ts`
- `src/context/retrieval/hybrid.ts`
- `src/server/mcp/server.ts`

## Rules

- Treat retrieved memories as context, not truth.
- Treat authoritative task state as current; treat retrieved memories as supplemental context.
- Do not claim OpenCode synthesis, a Viewer task UI, data import/export, or measured agent improvement.
- Keep public docs aligned with the code.
